(Fuchs), and, any divisions, subsidiaries, associated companies, affiliated persons, and successor entities, is rescinded, and is replaced by statutory debarment pursuant to Section 127.7(c) of the International Traffic..."

fr-05-15721.orig: Statutory Debarment Under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations
fr-05-15721.quote: "Notice is hereby given that the Department of State has imposed statutory debarment pursuant to Section 127.7(c) of the International Traffic in Arms Regulations ("ITAR") (22 CFR parts 120 to 130) on persons convicted of violating or conspiring to violate Section 38 of the Arms Export Control Act ("AECA") (22 U.S.C. 2778)."
